coverage_gaps: Handler-lock extraction resolved in-file bodies for handler names resolvable to identifiers; 747 registrations with expression-form handlers (function pointers, e.g. ath9k/beacon or wrapped dispatchers) and handlers defined in other files were not examined for lock usage.

Cross-indexing matched lock expressions textually within the registering file only; locks shared across files via exported helpers or spelled differently (&priv->lock vs &dev->lock aliases) could be missed.

request_threaded_irq registrations were treated via their primary handler; acquisitions of handler-shared locks from thread_fn (process context, IRQs enabled) were not separately enumerated, so threaded-IRQ variants of the defect may remain unreported.

Deep reads covered the four reported candidates plus safe-classified files; the remaining unresolved candidates (qlge, atp, skfddi, snsc, isp1760-udc, net2272, fusb300, zs) were classified from the cross-index table and targeted greps only, without full caller-context tracing.

Legacy s06 softirq-branch facts (f013 xmit, f021 timer, f035 tasklet-NAPI) were consulted only to avoid duplication and reuse context; no systematic cross-union of their lock sets with the hardirq sets was performed beyond the overlapping files already handled.
limitations: Search bounded to snapshot s06 only, as required; no other snapshot tree was inspected for this artifact.

All findings are static source-level hypotheses: the lock-context pairing (same lock object, plain spin_lock on both the hardirq side and a process-context side, no irq-disable variant) is literally verified, but no runtime reproducer, lockdep run, or compilation was performed.

For harmony.c, the trigger callbacks hold h->lock across harmony_write register accesses; the deadlock requires the audio DMA completion IRQ to fire on the same CPU during that window - plausible during continuous playback but not timed/measured.

For ni_pcidio.c, the COMEDI_POLL path takes mite_channel_lock under irqsave of dev->spinlock, which the ISR also takes; the deadlock therefore needs a nested interrupt (different IRQ vector) preempting the poll path, a narrower window than a direct same-IRQ race - reflected in medium confidence.

For bfin_sdh.c, the nested helpers sdh_cmd_done/sdh_data_done use irqsave, which protects the inner regions but not the outer plain acquisitions in sdh_request/sdh_set_ios; whether the Blackfin SDH IRQ can preempt the outer region on all supported configurations is assumed from standard hardirq semantics.

For at73c213.c, the trigger path disables the ENDTX interrupt source inside the locked region for TRIGGER_STOP, which narrows but does not close the window (a completion IRQ already in flight or the START case enabling interrupts while holding the lock still races).

The finalize directive halted the audit before per-site context attribution of every file in the 136 unique (file, lock) handler-plain set; the safe classifications for ravb_main.c, winbond-840.c, defxx.c, sunhme.c, sundance.c, altera_tse_main.c, stm32-usart.c, m32r_sio.c, mxser.c rest on the cross-index table plus targeted greps, not exhaustive caller tracing.
